mapper.select: SELECT kcc.id 'id', kcc.text_content 'textContent', kcc.upload_type 'uploadType', kcc.create_time 'createTime', su.nick_name 'username', kcc.attach_url 'attachUrl', kcc.create_by 'createBy', kcc.kg_id FROM kg_class_circle kcc INNER JOIN sys_user su ON kcc.create_by = su.user_id WHERE kcc.del_flag = 0 AND kcc.kg_id = #{queryVO.kgId} order by kcc.create_time desc
